title: One Dead Whale Feeds the Deep Sea for Decades

scenes.text: One dead whale feeds the deep sea for decades.
It sinks to the sea floor, where food is scarce.
That one body delivers as much food as thousands of years of drifting marine snow.
Sleeper sharks and hagfish strip the flesh first.
Then bone-eating worms called Osedax move in and dissolve the skeleton.
A single death becomes a city that lasts decades.

description:
One dead whale feeds the deep sea for decades.
When a whale sinks, scavengers eat the flesh, bone-eating Osedax worms dissolve the skeleton, and bacteria feed on what remains. Scientists estimate bones can support life for decades, and a carcass delivers food equal to thousands of years of marine snow.
What would you most want to see on the deep sea floor? Comment below.
first_comment: Which would you want to see first: the sharks, the hagfish or the zombie worms?
